political_impact.text: The Commission printed these rule changes in the annual reports it sent to Congress.

legacy.text: These are the opening orders in the numbered series of a president under whom the classified service grew from 106,205 positions on June 30, 1901 to 234,940 on June 30, 1909, growth that also reflects the expansion of the government itself.
legacy.source: U.S. Civil Service Commission, Thirty-Second Annual Report (1915), summary table

political_impact.text: The examination system for rural carriers went fully into effect on February 1, 1902, when 6,009 carriers were classified; by June 30, 1902 the service counted 8,590 classified carriers.
